card.name: First names in contact lines
card.fires_on: A person's first name (or the period after Dr/Prof) right after 'contact' or a title, where a surname comes next. Seen in web contact details and trial listings.

modes.label: First name after contact
modes.description: A first name following 'contact' or 'Contact:' before a surname and phone or email.
modes.example: For more information, contact<< Roger>> Hooks at (408)

modes.label: Period after title
modes.description: The period after Dr or Prof before an instructor's surname.
modes.example: Phil/FA 310 Introduction to Aesthetics Instructor: Dr<<.>> Norman Lillegard Office: H
